statement: There are n cities, numbered 0 to n − 1. Some pairs of cities are linked by a direct connection and some are not.
Connections carry through: if city a is directly connected to city b, and city b is directly connected to city c, then a and c are connected indirectly.
A province is a group of cities that are all connected to one another, directly or indirectly, and to no city outside the group.
You are given the n × n matrix isConnected, where isConnected[i][j] is 1 when city i and city j are directly connected and 0 otherwise. Return the number of provinces.

examples.explanation: Cities 0 and 1 are connected to each other and form one province. City 2 has no connection to either, so it is a province on its own.
No two cities are connected, so each of the three cities is its own province.
